mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the kidney signal to marrow precursors was most worthwhile: the low-oxygen cue gave red-cell renewal a regulatory purpose, rather than presenting it as simple replacement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the skin-cell population to the body was clear but mechanically predictable; the result offered little beyond the renewal already suggested by the item description.

surprise.text: The low-oxygen cue clarified why the kidney sends a signal to marrow; that connection was not explicit in the initial item title.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the bone-removal-then-formation sequence was a guess at first and the brief result did not explain what coordinates the two stages.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it explored a similarly useful connection between systems. The renewal examples were clear, though the combinations themselves were mostly predictable.
